object.absorption: moderate (~5x berberine HCl, still limited absolute)
object.notes: Reduced berberine form with markedly improved oral bioavailability vs berberine HCl (~5x; PMID 37057922). Absorption-only: scored above berberine HCl (6) and near the enhanced-delivery tier, though absolute absorption of berberine remains limited.

absorption_structured.notes: ~5x oral bioavailability vs berberine HCl (PMID 37057922)

object.notes: Pure L-isomer theanine (e.g. Suntheanine). Absorption-only: L-theanine is a small amino acid that is rapidly and actively absorbed in the small intestine (PMID 34115818); the D-isomer in racemic/unspecified product is less active. bio_score reflects good systemic absorption.

absorption_structured.notes: Rapidly absorbed small amino acid (PMID 34115818)

object.notes: Purified free lutein from marigold (e.g. FloraGLO, Lutemax 2020). Absorption-only: clinical-grade purity/standardization does NOT raise systemic absorption - lutein is a moderate, fat-dependent absorber; scored at the moderate tier, not premium, despite branding.

absorption_structured.notes: Moderate fat-dependent carotenoid absorption

object.absorption: excellent (~20x oral absorption vs unformulated quercetin)
object.notes: Patented lecithin-based phytosome delivery (Quercefit). Human PK shows ~20x improved oral absorption vs unformulated quercetin (PMID 30328058, Riva et al., Eur J Drug Metab Pharmacokinet 2019). bio_score reflects clinically demonstrated superior absorption.

absorption_structured.notes: ~20x relative oral absorption vs unformulated quercetin (PMID 30328058)
